articleTitle: Decision Support System in Online Training Process Management for Implementing Complex Open Ended Assignments in Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: A great variety of decision support systems is used to make quick and reliable decisions in educational activity in general and in engineering education in particular. The systems are applied in learning path planning, educational programmes implementation, online courses developing, online training process management, etc. Existing methods of decision making are not effective in case of online training process management in implementing complex open ended assignments, which cannot be checked by a test (for example, term papers, calculation and graphic works, laboratory works). Complex open ended assignments are widely used in the field of engineering education. That is why the problem of low training process management effectiveness in it is acute. A decision support method based on error classification with the use of intelligent technologies, such as cognitive modelling technology and knowledge engineering technology, and decision support system implementing the method are suggested in the paper. The decision support system allows to manage education training process regardless of assignment domain and can be applied in engineering education. Approbation of using and the assessment of the effectiveness of the decision support system was organized in online training process management during term paper performance in Ufa state aviation technical university as an example.

articleTitle: Educational Data Mining: Current Problems and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The generalization and systematization of various scientific views of both domestic and foreign researchers on the problem of educational data mining (EDM) and their application to support decision-making on the educational process management. Particular attention is paid to the problems of automatic extraction of interpreted knowledge from educational data in order to transfer it to users and facilitate the processes of interactive computing and communication among users. The proposed methods and models allow increasing the effectiveness of decision-making process at all stages of the educational process management. The novelty of the work results is a new approach to the extraction of interpretable knowledge based on the use of a special class of neural network models, as well as the hybridization of several approaches developed as part of data mining into a single learning environment in order to implement an end-to-end learning strategy, including the steps of data collecting and analyzing, knowledge extracting and management. The paper presents the fragments of the developed software that provides EDM by individual methods.

articleTitle: Investigation of Flow Characteristics for Drop-shaped Tubes Bundle Using Ansys Package
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Tube bundles can be used as a separation heat exchanger in the organic Rankine cycle power plants ORC, while the hot gas passes over the outer surface, and the working substance ORC flows inside the tubes. Numerical study of the hydrodynamics and heat transfer of a drop-shaped tubes bundle of various configurations at zero angle of attack of the incoming gas flow is carried out using the ANSYS package. The results of numerical simulation of pressure, velocity, temperature distribution in the bundle had provided the development of equation to determine the average Nusselt number in terms of Reynolds number, Prandtl number and angle of attack.

articleTitle: Structuring Information about the State of the Cyber-Physical System Operator
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Human operator, who manages complex equipment and makes responsible decisions, is occupied an important place in the cyber-physical system. His activity is accompanied by high psycho-emotional stress, which can negatively affect performance. Therefore, in the cyber-physical system, monitoring (including remote monitoring) of the functional state of a person is necessary. This article discusses the problem of structuring heterogeneous information, which is recorded during the monitoring process and is used to assess the state of the human operator. This information can be represented by various types of data (quantitative, qualitative, interval, in the form of time series, etc.), and it should be structured to facilitate the detection of hidden patterns and relationships. The features of structuring the flow of heterogeneous data for assessing the human state are given and methods for this assessment are highlighted. Solving the problems of structuring heterogeneous data is accompanied by examples.

articleTitle: A Method for Managing Engineers Training Processes using Swarm Intelligence Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The paper examines the problem of managing the training of engineers using modern information technologies and describes the method proposed to manage the training of engineers based on the rational choice of individual and team learning by selecting algorithms and parameters of the swarm intelligence algorithms. The application of the proposed method is considered on the example of training engineers in information technology using algorithms for swarming bees, ant colonies, fireflies, schools of fish.

articleTitle: Applying of Modeling Tools Pack SimInTech in the Engineering Personnel Preparation for the Energy Sector
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article subject is to consider the possibility of the laboratory work course implementation for the educational discipline "Computing machines, systems and networks" in the new russian software SimInTech for training bachelors in the direction of "Thermal energy and heat engineering" in connection with the trend of import substitution in Russia.

articleTitle: E-Learning Resource for Electric Machine Design
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This paper presents the work of e-learning resource which is used for training within the structure of engineering higher education. This project combines classic design techniques and new features of computer technology. It utilizes technologies of iterative design of electric machine and parametric selection technologies. The paper presents the work of e-learning resource for full-time and distance education.

articleTitle: Design of Tree-Like Database Structure for Solving Test Modeling Tasks of Energy Equipment Training
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Large enterprises of power engineering (PJSC Power Machines, JSC ROTEK, etc.) often have a large amount of experimental data that is used as a verification basis for the results of numerical simulation. In this case, the task arises of storing the received data and its use for training employees. Small companies do not have full experience and sufficient data to select the optimal settings, which can lead to high accuracy modeling. The solution is to create a database containing recommendations for choosing the settings of the grid and the solver module of modeling software. Recommendations can be generated by verification experiences and simulation results using experimental data.

articleTitle: TCAD and Cognitive Visualization in Electronic Engineering Education : BMSTU Case Study
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: In this paper we consider a possibility to use industrial TCAD software in electronic engineering education. Our investigation focus is on the aspects of their applications in Bauman Moscow State Technical University. We present our results and talk about opportunities of using TCAD in academic process.

articleTitle: Using of the Aerospace Modeling Simulator in the Educational Process
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The possibilities of using an aerospace simulator Kerbal Space Program as a platform for the implementation of modern study programs and scientific research are considered. The description of the developed study programs, the results of their practical approbation are represented, the content of educational and methodological support is described, examples of dissemination of experience at international conferences are considered. The adaptation of the developed study programs in the field of aerospace modeling, aimed at popularizing knowledge about Astronautics, obtaining of real skills in the program of space modeling, will help to save from stereotypes about the use of outdated knowledge and will raise the authority of Russian education in the international educational environment. The possible areas of use of the aerospace simulator for solving research problems are considered, the results of the development and simulation of a mobile production system for extracting fuel from the lunar soil are presented. Possible directions of further upgrowth are shown.

articleTitle: Use Arduino and Micro:bit as Teaching Platform for the Education Programming and Electronics on the STEM Basis
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The paper illustrates use of Arduino and Micro:bit in the education of the electronics and programming. The two-parts (Arduino and Micro:bit) electronic textbook is presented. The book follows the principles of modern teaching method STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics). This book is being tested in some schools and there is already the first feedback available. Both platforms are compared in this paper and there is given the recommendation for choosing the most effective platform.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of Regulators Based on Artificial Neural Networks in the Process of Training Specialists in Automated Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This paper describes the laboratory work "Neural networks application in automatic systems". Describes all the steps of implementing and testing the automatic control system with regard to the specific behavior of artificial neural networks. Also the technique of adjustment of optimal parameters of a neuroregulator in real control systems taking into account limitations of technical means of automation is offered.

articleTitle: Blended Learning and Self-Reflection as Tools for Developing IT-Students’ Soft Skills
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Industry 4.0 requires that an engineer or an IT-specialist possess universal competencies, or soft skills. These skills enable a professional to adapt to a rapidly changing environment, master new technologies, and find inventive solutions to problems. One of the objectives that the engineering education must fulfill is enhancing self-regulation and personal development skills in students. The paper analyses modern education technologies that enhance students’ soft skills. Special emphasis is given to the distant education and reflective process in the blended learning approach. Using the Flipped Classroom model, the authors have developed a new education course model that will foster self-regulation and personal development skills in students. Distant educational technologies enhances the possibilities of learning environment and autonomous learning. Reflexive instruments promote students’ understanding of their learning activity and the ways to improve it. We provide the pedagogical base and the special aspects of the course implementation. There is evidence that, compared with traditional approach, blended learning with elements of self-reflection is more effective in terms of developing self-regulation and personal development of students. The results of a survey that evaluated the perceived value of the course showed that the highest contribution was that the students acquired extensive experience in planning their learning activity, in evaluating their learning progress, their abilities and involvement. This paper can be of use for university teachers and researchers working to increase learning efficiency by introducing new education technologies.

articleTitle: Laboratory Works on Control Theory Using Scilab/Xcos
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This paper is devoted to a cycle of laboratory works on the control theory course for students of MPEI. This course was developed for the bachelor students of Institute of Thermal and Nuclear Power Engineering studying on the educational program "Automation of technological processes in thermal power engineering", so dynamical characteristics of plants and processes under consideration are typical for thermal ones, for example, surface heat exchangers. The cycle consists of five laboratory works which may be carried out in Matlab/Simulilnk or Scilab/Xcos. Short descriptions of the laboratory works are given, the purpose of each of them, the skills and knowledge being improved, developed or obtained through each laboratory works are specified. The paper also describes how the laboratory works are connected with other aspects of the control theory course and with other bachelor and master courses and how the results obtained by the students may be further used. In order to make the classes more interesting and useful for all students, some variants of varying laboratory works are described. Advantages of using Scilab/Xcos for these laboratory works are given.

articleTitle: Computer Adaptive Testing as an Automated Control of Students’ Level of Preparadness Taking into Account their Individual Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article discusses the questions of standardization of assessment procedures with an individual approach. Performance indicators such as time spent on organization and control, the number of tasks that are necessary for the estimating and the accuracy of the estimates obtained were defined as valid characteristics. In addition, the advantages of computer adaptive testing are presented. An algorithm of two- step adaptive testing is implemented, which is introduced on the basis of filtering according to a given initial information and the location of tasks by level of complexity. The organization of the modeling process using the adaptive test generation in the selected intervals of the measured scale is described. The scale for evaluating the results of computer adaptive testing, and the scheme of the algorithm at all three stages of testing are given.

articleTitle: Computational Model for High-Pressurized Heat Recovery Steam Generator Heat Transfer Study
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This article shows the main stages of computational model development for CFD (Computational Fluid Dynamics) research dedicated to High-Pressurized Heat Recovery Steam Generator (HPHRSG). This project could solve the problem of quick decommissioning and replacement of energy equipment. It has different structure comparing existing units made especially for decreasing the costs of reconstruction.The model was created in ANSYS CFX software. Several approaches have chosen to validate results of the model. The model allows quick geometrical and physical properties change for studying different heat transfer effects. Great attention is paid to the correct choice of mathematical models for studying the flow motion and heat transfer processes. The most applicable way of solving engineering tasks is the RANS (Reynolds Averaged Navier-Stokes equations) method. Several three-dimensional geometry models and computational meshes are shown. Key material features and model parameters are presented. Initial mesh has shown poor results although the mesh quality was high because of inflation layers lack. It is essential in questions of convective heat transfer study to make inflation layers.The results of research have shown that current model’s calculation time reduced by 2 times comparing initial version and accuracy of the results amounts less than 2% comparing the existing approaches.

articleTitle: E-Learning: Experience and New Challenges
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article is devoted to the e-learning development in Russian Federation. E-learning is seen as a product influenced by market regulatory mechanisms. The requirements for the structure and content of high-quality electronic courses, as well as to university professors as the creators of these products, are determined. Based on the experience of the National Research University "Moscow Power Engineering Institute", the authors analyzed the new challenges that students of educational programs using distance technologies face.

articleTitle: Tool Environment for Creating Training Prototypes of Intelligent Decision Support Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This paper presents the HUGIN tool software system, which is freely distributed. HUGIN is anticipation system for the development of applied intelligent systems (IS) using Bayesian confidence networks to find solutions. Examples of these are expert decision support systems (EDSS). The energy policy of the Russian Federation is in the transition to "digital energy" now, which requires the active use of modern information technology methods, including artificial intelligence methods. At the National Research University "MPEI" (NRU "MPEI"), when teaching students based on the materials "Applied Mathematics and Computer Science", several courses are taught on artificial intelligence and intelligent technologies (data and knowledge basis, reasoning modelling, non-traditional logic, expert systems, intelligent system programming, methods and software for decision support, and others). In the Expert Systems course, undergraduate students learn how to use EDSS for various applications. EDSS for monitoring and diagnosing a sophisticated energy facility.

articleTitle: Digital Technologies in the Educational Process of the Thermal Power Plant Department, Kazan State Power Engineering University
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The necessity of digital technologies using in the educational process with the growing demands on the quality of higher technical education is shown. The possibility of software using in the educational process at the Thermal Power Plants Department, of Kazan State Power Engineering University in considered.

Author Keywords: computer simulators of the Thermal Power Plants

articleTitle: Application of the Information and Communication Technologies in the Centre for Science and Education "Ecology in Power Engineering"
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article provides brief information about additional professional education in the energy sector. Features of activity of the Centre for Science and Education "Ecology in Power Engineering" of the Moscow Power Engineering Institute (hereafter – the Centre) are presented. The article contains various elements of information and communication technologies, used in the programs of training and retraining of the technical staff of power companies and industries, studying at the Centre in the fields "Heat Power Engineering and Heat Engineering" and "Electric Power Engineering and Electrical Engineering". It also describes the Information System "The Best Available and Perspective Nature Protection Technologies in the Russian Power Industry" containing information on all the aspects of environmental protection in the energy sector used as the information tool during the teaching process.

articleTitle: Approaches to the Implementation of Information-Analytical Processes in Complex Technical-Organizational Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This article is devoted to analyzing the approaches to the implementation of information-analytical processes in complex technical-organizational systems. Every complex technical-organizational system has subsystems of obtaining of the incoming information and information-analytical processes of analyzing it. Among approaches to implementation of data verification manual, automatic, data clustering and neural network approaches were reviewed. Analysis of approaches to the implementation of information-analytical processes has included the implementation by developers in the program code of the system, implementation by experts in the program code of the system, implementation by experts in the software-instrumental environment of the system. In addition, the analysis of approaches to evaluation of the results of information-analytical processes was carried out. Calculation on request and calculation in the background approaches were reviewed. Every given situation declares special conditions to the approaches to implementation of data verification and information-analytical processes as well as its evaluation time scale. These approaches have been compared. System implementation example industrial information system of collecting and processing data GIAP-DISTcenter has been presented. The developed system, is capable of injuring and processing information, creating and promptly implementing changes in information-analytical processes using it’s software and instrumental environment and evaluating the results of these changes. It is shown how to obtain a synergistic effect by combining different approaches and ensuring interaction between them using analytical and neural network modules..

articleTitle: Improving the Effectiveness of the Information Module for the Interaction between Universities and Employers
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The current level of the information technologies, economy digitalization development indicates the need to improve the system of interaction between universities and enterprises, which are potential employers of graduates. The urgency of the problem reinforces the need of enterprises for the prompt selection of specialists who satisfy the required level of competencies. The authors proposed the information module «University plus Employer», which interacts with students, graduates and employers. Based on the methodology of system analysis, quality systems, methods for evaluating technical and economic efficiency, the approach to evaluating the integral indicator of module efficiency at the design stage (according to functional indicators) and at the operation stage (according to operational indicators)is offered. A methodology has been developed for evaluating the integral indicator of the effectiveness of the "University plus Employer" module, which takes into account that operating indicators change over time and, therefore, characterize the module effectiveness in dynamics. The possibility of developing and implementing the new information module "University + Employer" is confirmed by an increase in the integral quality indicator by functional indicators by more than four times.

Author Keywords: interaction between the university and employers

articleTitle: Research on Mobile Manipulators Singular Kinematics by Computer Algebra Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Using the KUKA youBot mobile manipulator for research and education as an example, concepts such as kinematic redundancy, the Jacobian matrix of a robot, singular configurations, and manipulability are analyzed applying Mathematica. Examples of research work with the participation of undergraduates are given, including animation of the KUKA youBot movements that are not implemented in singular configurations.

articleTitle: Alternative Approaches to Data Storing and Processing
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Most data processing applications store data using a Database Management System (DBMS). The most widely used DBEs belong to relational. In these engines, data is stored in a number of tables. One of the main relational DBMS interface technologies is Structured Query Language (SQL), but there are alternative approaches, like Query By Example (QBE). Since relational databases have poor performance on some types of data, there have appeared other approaches. They in unite called "No-SQL databases", although these approaches are very different from each other. Graph-based and document-based DBMS belongs to them. In this paper, we describe common implementations of relational and No-SQL DBMS and compare their capabilities using a practical example.

articleTitle: Acceleration of Monte Carlo Simulation of Electron Transport
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This work describes new acceleration for Monte Carlo modelling: elimination of the inelastic channel from direct modelling and matrix MC modelling. Efficiency of MatLab package for solving the problems of electron scattering in solid by means of the Monte Carlo method. This approach is actively used in educational research.

articleTitle: Software Application for Research on the Organization of Cyclic Production of Multi-assorted Products
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Modern software systems designed for modeling and synthesis of flexible chemical-technological systems are considered, as part of their application in teaching students the whole spectrum of engineering areas related to chemical technology. The necessity of developing a software application for optimizing the production of an assortment of products is substantiated, the algorithm of its operation and examples of use in the educational process are described.

Author Keywords: ways of organizing the assortment release

articleTitle: Mathematical and Physical Modeling Cooling Process for Solid Waste Tire Pyrolysis Products
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The report focuses on the development and implementation of the method for determining the thermal conductivity of coke residue. Coke residue is the product of waste tire pyrolysis. The method is based on the use of physical and mathematical modeling with varied use of IT. Experiments for study the cooling process of the coke residue layer in the air in the temperature range from 500 °C to ambient temperature have been performed. The temperature and time dependences at several points of the layer have been obtained. A mathematical model of the measuring chamber reproducing the experimental conditions has been developed. Based on the study of the mathematical model, it is possible to determine the thermal conductivity of the coke residue, which approximates with satisfactory accuracy the calculated temperature curves of the cooling process to those obtained in the experiment. The error in determining the thermal conductivity is estimated by the response function – mean-square deviation of the calculated temperatures from the experimental ones at the given point of the coke residue volume during the experiment. In the framework of this approach, the solved problem belongs to the class of inverse problems of thermal conductivity. Based on the analysis of experimental data, two temperature intervals are distinguished, in each of which the thermal conductivity of the backfill is described by a linear temperature function. The coefficients of these two functions are determined by minimizing the response function using the Box-Wilson method. The obtained results are used for the development of industrial heat power facilities. The developed method and supporting software are used in scientific researches, as well as in the educational process in the preparation of bachelors, masters and graduate students.

articleTitle: The Use of Computer Graphics in the Study of the Geometric Modeling Course
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This article discusses the developed practical and homework exercises of the Geometric Modeling course in the direction of graduate training 02.03.01 Mathematics and Computer Science (specialization Mathematical and Computer Modeling). They are devoted to computer geometric modeling techniques using various spline representations and basic logical operations on geometric constructions of complex curved shapes. The spline representations include linear and bilinear splines, Hermite cubic splines and Hermite surfaces, natural cubic and bicubic interpolating splines, Bezier curves, rational Bezier curves, NURBS curves and NURBS surfaces. We consider Boolean operations of the intersection of two spline curves and the intersection of two parametric surfaces. Screenshots of some graphic windows of the developed software are shown. The software has a web interface using the WebGL graphics library in a browser. It is used by students in completing tasks for preparing the initial data and visualizing the results of the constructions. Tasks for four practical exercises in a computer laboratory and sample homework exercises are given.

articleTitle: Modeling Cryptographic Protocols Using Computer Algebra Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: We present the IT solutions for modeling of cryptographic protocols for educational purposes and compare three approaches. The first approach is based on protocol implementation provided by computer algebra system Sage, the second is based on the MPEI algebraic processor, and the third implementation uses combination of Sage and MPEI algebraic processor. Sage provides excellent implementations of some typical algebraic elements used for cryptographic protocol execution as well as examples of their usage. But Sage does not support remote modeling of cryptographic protocol interactions, while MPEI algebraic processor does. The article proposes an integration of these two systems, which will allow us to use Sage for remote execution of cryptographic protocols via the Internet. Moreover, the algebraic processor can provide access to a more detailed study of the Sage. The importance of studying information security in the context of industrial systems and in particular cryptographic primitives by future IT specialists is emphasized.

articleTitle: Engineering Calculation of Induction Crucible Furnace with MATLAB/Simulink
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: A simulation model has been developed in MATLAB with the Simulink extension package for engineering calculations of an induction crucible furnace and a thyristor frequency converter, which can be used at the conceptual stage of designing an induction crucible furnace and a power source. The simulation model contains original blocks that allow calculating electromagnetic and thermal phenomena taking into account the load alterations during induction heating of steel.

articleTitle: Development of Software for the Automated Calculation Performance Induction Heating Gradient Blanks
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The description of the automated calculation procedure for the developed mathematical model of induction gradient heating of the workpieces is presented in detail. Using mathematical modeling, the system "inductor – magnetic circuit – billet" is studied using the example of the installation of induction gradient heating of measured cylindrical billets before pressure treatment as part of the course design.

articleTitle: Software Environment for Studying Intelligent Anytime Heuristic Search Methods
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Anytime algorithms are widely used in real-time intelligent systems because they offer a tradeoff between solution quality and solving time. This property of them is valuable when the first solution can be obtained much faster than obtaining an optimal solution with the classical algorithm. In this paper, we describe several frameworks for making anytime-algorithms from classical heuristic searches and introducing a C++ implementation of these algorithms useful for demonstrating to the students the concept of an anytime heuristic search, its use, properties and tuning. These algorithms are studied by students who are studying in the master's program in the field of "Applied mathematics and Informatics" when studying methods and systems of artificial intelligence (discipline "Methods and software tools for decision support").

articleTitle: Practicially-Oriented Approach to Training at the National Research University "Moscow Power Engineering Institute" in the Conditions of "Industry 4.0" and Its Problems
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article discusses the problems of the student practice organizing in conditions of a significant expansion of the technological capabilities and dynamics of the professions demand structure development.

Author Keywords: support of the educational process in the field of practical training

articleTitle: MATHPOL: Development of Mathematical Competencies in Engineering Students using Project-Oriented Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This paper presents a way to develop mathematical competencies in engineering students, using project-oriented learning. These projects use cutting-edge technology and applications such as 3D printing, augmented reality and modeling with Mathematica and Python, and have been specifically designed to develop eight mathematical competencies: thinking and reasoning, argumentation, communication, modeling, posing and solving problems; representation, making use of language and symbolic operations, and use of aids and tools. A pre-test and a post-test were applied to 239 students to measure the number of initial and final mastery of the mathematical competencies. Statistical tests show that students significantly increase the domain levels in math competencies. We also gave perception questionnaires to our students about using this type of projects to learn Calculus. Our results indicate that there is a positive impact on student engagement and that the use of technology plays an important role in helping to develop these competencies.

articleTitle: The Problem of Ensuring Cross-border Personal Data Transfer and Methods for Its Solving
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article considers the problem of cross-border transfer of information containing personal data of students of branches of higher educational institutions in other countries. A review of regulatory documents in the field of regulation of cross-border transfer of personal data is made. Existing methods and software and hardware for transmitting personal data over computer networks are analyzed. A hardware and software for cross-border data transfer between the university and its branches in other countries is proposed. It is pointed out the need to prepare internal university regulations in the field of cross-border data transmission.

articleTitle: The Use of Building Information Modeling Technology in Designing
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: A modern approach to the design of industrial and public buildings requires the use of the latest technology. The most promising area in this industry is Building Information Modeling (BIM). Thanks to the use of BIM technologies, the design process is significantly accelerated and much fewer errors occur. In this article, the Revit software package is selected as an example of a 3D design environment. This program has a fairly convenient and functional interface, allows you to configure connections with other programs, and it has a Dynamo visual programming module that allows you to speed up and automate many standard functions.

articleTitle: Applied Aspects of the Integrated Problem Solving System with Natural Language Interface
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This paper describes a concept of automatic problem solving system which implies close integration of linguistic processing, ontological representation of the problem, heuristic-oriented solution and interactive visualization. The concept is based on Polya methodology adapted for computer implementation. The system was implemented as a dummy program and tested in "school geometry" area. Experiments confirmed prospects of the concept and feasibility of its use for creation of a qualitatively higher level training system were carried out.

articleTitle: The Use of Modern Computer-Based Training-Simulator Complexes in the Educational Process
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The questions of application of training computer simulators for training of future specialists-power engineers in higher education institution are considered. Examples of specific research problems solved with the help of all-mode simulators are given. The attention is paid to methodical approaches of students training at use in educational process of computer training complexes, and also to their features of technical realization.

articleTitle: Improving Laboratory Work on Switching Devices through the Use of 3D-Visualization of a Heavy-Duty Circuit Breaker Model
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This article discusses the use of 3D modeling capabilities to improve textbooks and teaching materials. Using Autodesk Inventor, a detailed 3D model of a circuit breaker has been developed. Based on the dynamic module of the software, a video review of this unit was created clearly showing not only its design but also the principle of operation.

articleTitle: Introducing Virtual Reality in an Automated Manufacturing Systems course - First approach
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Currently, Information Technologies (IT) are widely used in the automation of manufacturing systems to exchange data between different workstations along the production lines. To manage the information that is handled, software applications are required that understand communications between various industrial equipment such as robots, CNC machines, parts storage systems, programmable logic controllers (PLC), vision systems and materials handling systems. To be able to perform simulations of the manufacturing processes and allow users to be present in a virtual way within the production systems, Virtual Reality (VR) is used. In recent years, the use of VR has become a key element, both in the Industrial area and in the field of Education. For students, they must know the advantages and disadvantages of the different software applications that allow generating production lines through VR; since in this way, they will know the scope of each of these computational tools. Nowadays, most Mechatronics Engineering curricula do not include a subject that involves the use of VR in the different areas of Mechatronics; Therefore, it is necessary to find alternatives for students to learn on their own, the applications that this technology has in their professional field. The above must be achieved without using the time of normal classes since the original syllabus would be neglected. This article shares the experiences obtained by introducing VR in a Manufacturing Systems Automation course through the use of Research-based learning methodology followed by a sequence of activities. To know the students' perception of the use of VR in their course, a survey was applied at the end of the semester.

articleTitle: Online Identification of Transformer Internal Faults Based on the Parameters of the Operating Mode
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This paper investigates the effectiveness of the diagnosing internal damage method to a three-phase power transformer without disconnecting from the network. This method is based on taking into account the correlation between the difference of instantaneous input and output voltage values and the input current of a one transformer phase for various types of faults. Simulation of the real transformer operation is carried out using three-dimensional computer simulation

Author Keywords: diagnostics without disconnecting from the network

articleTitle: Development of a Knowledge Base on the Topics of Theoretical Electrical Engineering Using Software Tools for Analysis and Generation of Collections of WIKI Articles
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The paper discusses issues related to the development of modern computer training tools. The use of artificial intelligence methods opens up new possibilities in the creation of computer-aided training tools and knowledge bases in various problem (subject) areas. It is proposed to solve these problems with the help of the developed software module for analysis and generation of wiki article collections for creating computer-based training aids using the knowledge base on theoretical foundations of electrical engineering as an example.

articleTitle: Software Package Development to Improve Occupational Safety at Electric Power Industry Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article describes the main approaches of software package development to improve the culture of labor safety at the electric power industry enterprises, which can be used in the framework of training and retraining programs for labor protection specialists and employees of energy enterprises responsible for work safety. The results of the analysis of software products currently existing in this area are presented.Аnalysis of opportunities, technical requirements, prevalence, application area, technical support, advantages and disadvantages of software for training and professional development is carried out. The key drawbacks associated with the complexity of the interface, late updating of information, the presence of unverified information, and incompatibility with many operating systems are identified. The structure and content of software main sections being developed is proposed. It includes: a database of legal documents in the field of industrial safety, tests and training complex, a service with online support of experts, reference articles and supporting documents.

articleTitle: Actualization of Graphic Training on the Basis of Design Activity
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article discusses actualization of graphic training on the basis of project activities in the development of the integrative discipline "Engineering geometry and computer graphics" implemented as part of the basic geometric and graphic training of students at the Perm National Research Polytechnic University. Prerequisites for applying an integrative approach in accordance with innovations in engineering design and modern requirements for the design culture of future graduates are discussed. The relevance of implementing project methods for geometric-graphic training of students is considered. A comprehensive project assignment is proposed that integrates various sections of the discipline and simulates real project activity.

articleTitle: Model of the Reliability of the Communication between Nodes of a Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The application in the educational process a computer model of the calculating reliability of the communication between nodes in wireless sensor networks is considered. The model allows to estimate probability of the successful transmission messages for given process parameters. The advantage of this model is the dynamic visualization of probability when changing a parameter of the model, availability of examples and exercises for working with the model. Developed model can be used in the design of the networks, as well as in engineering education.

articleTitle: Problems and Challenges in Education in ICT at the Poznan University of Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: In this paper, we describe the current status of university education in the area of electronics and telecommunications, teleinformatics, computer science and artificial intelligence at the Poznan University of Technology. We describe the method of admission for the above fields of studies, and problems faced by freshmen resulting from the education curricula in high schools in Poland, in particular in mathematics and informatics. Next, we shortly describe most of the fields of studies offered at PUT in Information and Communication Technologies (ICT). We also present a description of the newly introduced field of studies, namely, "Artificial Intelligence". We also show how the job offers influence candidates for Ph.D. studies, and present the prospects of scientific careers. It is a problem of relations with industry, which on one hand have a form of cooperation, but on the other, create serious competition for the development of university scientific staff in ICT.

articleTitle: Software for Training Process Discipline Simulation Methods
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The main software interfaces for tasks on the following topics are presented: automatic control system (ACS) simulation scheme construction, proportional-integral parameters optimization and analysis of its operation quality. The technique of the proposed material for studying is characterized by combining approaches to practical ACS adjustment by simulation models with programs of modern evolutionary optimization algorithms with subsequent study of the character of optimized indicators response surfaces.

articleTitle: A Methodology of Modeling The IEEE 802.11 Wireless LAN Using ns-3
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This paper aims to introduce a methodology of wireless LAN modeling using ns-3. There is a lot of analytical models has been proposed to estimate the performance of IEEE wireless LAN, but all of these models contain a lot of assumptions and have not been fully investigated using modeling or real experiments. The raising complexity of media access control protocols of IEEE 802.11 and programming their models cause problems to verify the theoretical results. The ns-3 is discrete event network simulator which provides an accurate implementation of IEEE 802.11[1]-[3]. This tool could be used for modeling the different application traffic with broad range of IEEE 802.11 wireless media access protocol settings. The methodology and example of testbed for modeling IEEE 802.11 DCF wireless LAN using ns-3 are given.

articleTitle: On One Method for Monitoring and Assessing Trainee's Cognitive Activity
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Modern technical equipment can help in controlling the brain electrical activity and other functional systems, which creates the conditions for creating systems for monitoring human cognitive activity using an objective assessment of trends in individual characteristics by the EEG signal. To analyze the brain electrical activity, we used the methods of spectral analysis and nonlinear dynamics. Based on power spectra estimates, as well as the characteristics of attractors reconstructed from EEG signal fragments, we have created signal descriptions for a calculation window. Taking into account the number of random factors that can cause changes in the EEG signal characteristics, further analysis included fuzzy algorithms. This paper presents the results of experimental studies of the described monitoring algorithms for five signal characteristics. In order to integrate the proposed approach with the educational process at Tver State Technical University, there were test lessons with students in the field of "Bioengineering systems and technologies". Preliminary results revealed students' interest in new methodological techniques and made it possible to select candidates for further experiments.

articleTitle: Information Architecture to Support Technical Education Training for Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article describes the prospects for the development of technologies that can contribute to the transition to Industry 4.0, by making appropriate changes in the enterprise architecture. A formal description of the enterprise is given based on the architectural approach, which allows increasing the efficiency of business information support for the organization of the digital industry. Changes in the approach of training of personnel of engineering education which are necessary for transition of the enterprises to the Industry 4.0 are considered.

articleTitle: Chasles’ Theorem as a 3D Analogue of Pascal’s Theorem
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The geometrical peculiarity of the line of mutual intersection of second-order surfaces and tetrahedron is considered, which is the essence of Chasles’ theorem. 3D models have been developed, which vividly illustrate different variants of the theorem. The method of building 3D models is given, which allows to use those in an educational course on the theoretical basics of geometrical modeling. A proof for one of the theorem variants is given. A conclusion has been made on the necessity to develop illustrative examples for all the variants of the theorem and its universal proof. The work has been performed using 3D computer modeling in AutoCAD package and SolidWorks.

articleTitle: STEM Technology Education
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article describes how modern computer mathematical programs can be used for innovative way of teaching at an engineering university and for a "fresher" solution to the classical problem of pendulum oscillation. New types of pendulum are proposed, in particular, a diver-pendulum with a "smile" phase portrait. It is shown that linearization can be rejected when modeling the oscillations of a rigid and elastic pendulum, taking into account the resistance of the medium. The scenario of a lesson at an engineering university using STEM technology is described.

articleTitle: Virtualization of the Behavior of Structures from Rubber-like and Metal Composites
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article is devoted to mathematical modeling of large (geometrically nonlinear) deformations and displacements of rubber-like materials and metal alloys. It is shown that the Cauchy’s tensor equally correctly describes the transformations for large, small, and infinitesimal values of gradients. A new approach to the formulation and solution of boundary value problems of statics is proposed. A mathematical model has been developed to analyze the stress-strain state of various structures. Developed computer programs calculate and build virtual graphs of transformations of various bodies under load and can be used when students study various sections of the mechanics of a deformable solid body.

articleTitle: The Advantages of Using Computer Algebra System Maple in Learning Differential Equation
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The paper dwells upon the original experience of using computer algebra system (CAS) Maple when engineering students learn differential equations. The authors give some examples of tasks. The students use computing and graphical capabilities (power) of CAS Maple to solve them. The scholars give a description of the findings of the experiment, which confirmed the effective use of CAS Maple when studying differential equations. The students in the experimental group improved academically by 10%. In addition, completion rate of research-level tasks in the final test turned out to be greater than twice in the experimental group.

articleTitle: Development of an Algorithm for Searching the Optimal Trajectory of the Object in the Conditions of Given Restrictions
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article discusses the development of a mathematical model of a mobile robot and a creation of an algorithm for searching the optimal trajectory of a mobile robot in the presence of obstacles in its path. The document describes the kinematic model of the robot and given trajectory on which experiments will be done. The article includes a block diagram of the developed algorithm and experimental results of its modeling.

articleTitle: Some Aspects of Individual Approach to Learning Based on Tutoring Integrated Expert Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Issues of intelligent individual education are of particular relevance today. This paper describes some aspects of building an individual strategy of education and training of young specialists with the help of tutoring integrated expert systems, which have been developed and used in the educational process of MEPhI for many years.

articleTitle: Embedding Interactive Python Web Applications into Electronic Textbooks
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The technology of operative embedding of interactive web applications into electronic textbooks is considered in the article. The possibilities of using Pyviz Panel and Plotly Dash technologies to create interactive web applications embedded in electronic textbooks are analyzed. The technology allowing to convert Python functions into web applications is considered, approaches to embed the converted Python applications into electronic textbooks are proposed.

Author Keywords: automated construction of the user interface

articleTitle: Comparison of Different Variants of Regulators with Constant Speed Actuators Working with Low-Inertia Plants
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This paper considers two variants of regulators with constant speed actuators working with low-inertia plants. The first variant is equipped with a relay-impulse regulating block based on a relay element with an inertia feedback. The second one has a regulating block calculating the speed of regulation combined with a pulse-wide modulator. The comparison is made on the basis of the analysis of a closed loop performance and uses simulation modelling, non-linear modes when the available speed of the actuator is lower than the calculated speed are also considered. This situation can happen in the feed water flow loop in a typical boiler-feed control system. It is shown that if the speed limitation is considerable, the first variant has certain advantages, because it can provide a better transient process quality while in the other system sustained oscillations may occur. In order to explain the result obtained the analysis of the equivalent frequency response is made by means of simulation modelling. It is shown that the first variant of the regulator working with the limited regulation speed has lower phase delay and this is the advantage of this variant.

articleTitle: Practical Aspects of Creating a Teacher's Information Space
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article discusses one of the aspects of digitalization of education, in terms of digitalization of the educational process itself. The methodology of creating a personal information space of a teacher is presented. The form of this space is a teaching site with teaching materials. A method for structuring methodological content is proposed. The methodology of posting structured content on a WordPress blog is described. A method for creating media content for special disciplines of technical areas of training is considered. The analysis of educational video content presented on the Internet is carried out. A step-by-step methodology for creating a video lesson in the Camtasia Studio program based on the Power Point presentation is described. There is an example of its application, successfully implemented in the educational process.

articleTitle: Automation Methodology for Complex Technical-Organizational Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This article is devoted to methodology of automation of complex technical-organizational systems. Traditional approaches suffer from semantic gaps in the transfer of information from an expert to a knowledge engineer and from a knowledge engineer to developers, duplication of data in the system, complexity, and, often, the inability to organize relationships between data in different modules, necessity to involve developers to create new system applications, make changes to the logic and displaying data in the existing applications. All those factors lead to decrease of the flexibility and versatility of software lifecycle. The proposed approach designed to optimize the automation software lifecycle. It is proposed to decline the hard-coded systems, and embrace the software-instrumental environment, which allows to the Expert (advanced user of Excel, for example), set up the ontological data structure and implement business processes without including knowledge engineers and developers in its lifecycle. Using this approach, the semantic gap is being eliminated; the involvement of developers is only necessary in a situation when it is necessary to develop new or adjust existing tools of the environment. It is proposed to include in software structure ontological component, utilizing object-oriented approach to implement data structure and business processes; analytical component to process data and generate analytical information; user-interaction component to provide end-user with all needed functionality and background processes component. System implementation example industrial information system of collecting and processing data GIAP- DISTcenter has been presented

articleTitle: Graph Analysis for Thermal Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Algorithms of comparison of network graphs by coincidence of vertex sets with the same eccentricity or weight with respect to the centroid are considered. The code fragments of the proposed techniques are given. The comparison method can be used in simulators for remote training of operators and engineers of thermal networks, where the developed scheme is compared with the test one.

articleTitle: Using Visualization in the Educational Process in the Direction of Environmental Protection
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article discusses various aspects of using visualization in training specialists in the field of environmental protection. The features of environmental data that make it difficult to analyze them without visualization are shown. Examples of using environmental information visualization in the educational process and in practice are given. Options for choosing the optimal graphical way to represent environmental data are given, depending on the tasks set. The current possibilities of using geoinformation systems in environmental education are considered. The prospects of joint application of geoinformation systems and common communication tools for creating local and global systems for on-line monitoring of environmental parameters are shown.

articleTitle: Problems and Methods for Forming Educational Results in the Implementation of Engineering Education in the Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article considers the task of training qualified specialists on the basis of a competency-based approach to training in areas and specialties of higher engineering education.A competency-based approach to teaching is currently the main aspect in the field of higher education, the fundamental principle of developing federal educational standards and sample educational programs, training materials, etc. The formation of competencies for the design of basic educational programs of higher education is declared on the basis of professional standards within the framework of the adopted FSES HE 3 ++, however, the labor functions described in professional standards often require additions and adjustments for the needs of a particular employer. The article presents an algorithm for the formation of educational results in the form of a competency model of a graduate taking into account the requirements of the employer, which is the basis of the intellectual system for designing the optimal competency model of a graduate of a university.

articleTitle: The Use of National and International Standards in Developing CAD Models of Electrical Substations
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: To improve the quality of project documents, reduce the time and resources required for their preparation, it is necessary to use computer-aided design (CAD) systems. Many large electricity companies include the introduction of CAD in their innovative development programs. In the framework of this work, the authors studied issues related to the creation of a trial version of the training and research CAD system of electrical substations, gained experience in the application of national and international CAD regulatory documents.

articleTitle: Experience of Mastering Information Technologies by Qualified Users
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article presents the experience of mastering information technologies by listeners of professional retraining courses studying in the fields of "Heat Power Engineering and Heat Engineering" and "Electric Power Engineering and Electrical Engineering", implemented in the Centre for Science and Education "Ecology in Power Engineering". An assessment of the current situation using traditional and new information technologies by specialists working in the energy sector is given. The shortcomings and gaps in the knowledge of listeners that do not allow the effective use of computer technology in various fields of their activity are analyzed. The ways and methods of applying active learning methods to acquire skills in solving production problems using information technology are shown.

articleTitle: The Study of Computer Simulation as a Method of Cognition in the Teaching of Technical and Natural Sciences
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: An article is devoted to investigation of computer simulation as the method of active learning for the technical specialties students. Methodological recommendations on the use of the computer simulation methods, its formalization and limitations and the features of Computer Simulation as a Method of Knowledge Synthesis are considered. The proposed approaches were applied in educational process for the masters’ programs «Radio Engineering» and «Applied Informatics», whic is carried out on the basis of software and hardware of the Space monitoring center of the Ural Federal University.

articleTitle: Usage of 3D Modeling in Engineering Education on the Example of the Noise Silencers Development
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article substantiates the expediency of 3D modeling technologies implementation in the educational process. Complex solution of problems from different areas of engineering knowledge demonstrated on the example of noise silencers designs development. With the help of software products, students are training to solve a set of problems facing the designer. The proposed method forms the holistic understanding of problems by developing a design simultaneously with the performance of strength, thermal and aerodynamic calculations for the same model. The qualitative difference from the existing teaching methods is that students are forced to general analyze the developed model taking into account the operating conditions. At the same time, in working on one product, students should use the knowledge obtained in various fields of engineering science. This allows to develop the skill of working with different sources of information in the application to a single product. The acquired skills are using in future to perform scientific researches.

articleTitle: Application of the Finite Element Method for Expanding the Capabilities of Educational Programs for Non-destructive Testing of Industrial Facilities
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Any industrial facilities require condition monitoring of many parts and units. There are many non-destructive testing methods. For teaching each method, a special training course and its own educational program are required. But unfortunately it’s not enough. As for many other technical courses there is a need for laboratories with a large amount of equipment. The most important part of the necessary equipment are defectoscopes, probes, and industrial samples. Defectoscope is very expensive equipment, but you can still buy them one-time, but with probes and samples everything is much more complicated. Best way for education is to give each student their own individual tasks, but in real conditions there is a very limited set of probes, as well as industrial samples for monitoring. The problem is also the lack of complete information about the structure of the probes themselves. This is not so important when training just defectoscope users, but we are training students who will later become developers and scientists. In this situation, modeling and calculation using the finite element method is the best choice. This method opens up the possibility of researching any industrial objects, it is only necessary to create a model and set its necessary properties. Also, students get the opportunity to easily simulate a new probe or to change some of its parameters, which greatly expands the possibilities of research, and also makes it possible to personalize tasks.

articleTitle: About Possibility of Application of the Automated Systems of the Account of Energy Resources in Training and Research Programs
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Today market relations between the supplier and the consumer of energy require qualitative accounting of its consumption. This problem is solved by the introduction of automated systems. However, such systems require a certain level of training, which is difficult to imagine without training on existing installations.

articleTitle: Education of Labor Protection and Environmental Engineering Specialists Based on Neural Network Data Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The application of the express-analysis model of the breathing cycle in the educational process using a computer complex developed at the Department Engineering ecology and labor safety of the National Research University "MPEI" is considered. The model helps to work out the skills for detecting symptoms of impairment of the functional state of the respiratory system. The proposed model is based on artificial neural networks and can be used for other subject areas and applications, including engineering education.

articleTitle: Program System "Decision-Making: Procedures on Graphs"
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The program system "Decision Making: Procedures on Graphs" allows solving optimal choice problems on discrete sets alternatives. The system implements both classical and algorithms developed by the authors of the mathematical theory of decision making and graph theory. The proposed algorithms allow us to build a consistent aggregate preference relation, as well as select the best alternatives or order them by preference. The system of programs is intended both for solving practical engineering problems, and for conducting laboratory and practical classes in the courses "Mathematical Theory of Decision Making", "Discrete Mathematics"

articleTitle: Testing System for Graphic Disciplines
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article presents the author’s knowledge testing system developed at the Department of Engineering Graphics, NRU "MPEI". The analysis of exiisting knowledge testing systems used in technical universities to test knowledge in graphic disciplines is carried out. Distinctive features and advantages of the developed knowledge testing system in comparison with existing solutions are revealed. The structure and capabilities of the knowledge control program and subsystem for self-preparation of the student for knowledge control are described. The article also demonstrated examples of test items.

articleTitle: Modernization of Siemens SPPA-T3000 Laboratory with the Use of Real-Time Container
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The description of the laboratory complex on the basis of PTC SIEMENS SPPA-T3000 of the NRU "MPEI" Department of automated control system of thermal processes for specialists in automation of technological processes in power training, the principles of operation of the complex, its differences from traditional program technical complex (PTC), and also modernization for work with natural signals are considered.

articleTitle: Temperature Field Modeling Technique of a Thermoelectric Generator, Taking in Account Parasitic Internal Sources
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This paper is devoted to the problem of taking into account internal thermal processes of thermoelectric generator (TEG) in temperature field modeling. TEG include several number of modules, which have a complex structure with a large number of small internal sources of different capacities, and to describe them in a model the direct mathematical modeling approach is need. But because of the complex multi-level structure of TEG, it is not always possible to implement this approach. The paper presents a methodology for the temperature field calculating in a TEG, which allows to implement this approach and to take into account the influence of thermal processes in TEG. The technique also simplifies TEG design description in the computational domain.

articleTitle: Numerical Models of Heat Conductivity of Composite Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: A method of computer simulation of the effective thermal conductivity of a unit cell of a composite system (CS) based on polymers has been developed. A review of methods for calculating the effective thermal conductivity of binary CSs is presented. The factors affecting the effective thermal conductivity of CSs are described, including the distribution of the filler in the matrix, the model of thermal conductivity in the interfacial layer, and the intermolecular thermal conductivity of polymers. Algorithms for obtaining the distribution of the filler in the matrix are proposed.. Experimental data of the effective thermal conductivity of composites based on polyethylene and polyamide with a filler of carbide particles of various dispersion are presented Based on the experiment and simulation, the thermal resistance of the interfacial layer was estimated. The use of developed software for scientific and educational purposes is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Innovative Technologies in the Estimation of Oscillation Frequencies of Composite Structures with the use of Audio Recording Equipment in the Laboratory of Dinamics and Strength of Machines
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The work is devoted to the use of audio recording equipment and further digital processing to assess the frequency of free oscillations of the beam made of composite material in the mechanics laboratory of the Department of RMDPM NRU "MPEI".

Author Keywords: acoustic and video fixation of beam oscillations

articleTitle: System for Quality Assurance of Study Programs in the Area of Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The problem with mastering of information and cognitive technologies in Russia, related to the poor organization of engineering study programs, is stated. Causes of the problem include the lack of problem-oriented leaning, non-correspondence of the engineering education to the requirements of Occupational standards and increasing demands from the labor market due to the technological progress. The necessities for using of breakthrough technologies are considered. The ways and approaches for solving of the problem are proposed, among them CDIO-approach and Quality assurance of study programs. The essence of CDIO-approach implementation is considered, application of CDIO model in study programs of Peter the Great St.Petersburg Polytechnic University is described. The necessity of Study programs’ quality monitoring on the feedback from interested parties is proved.

articleTitle: Forming of Curvilinear Structures Based on Polyhedrons by the Projectivographical Method
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The possibilities of forming curvilinear structures by the projectivographic method for use in architecture and design are considered. As is known, the projectivographic method allows new polyhedral structures to be obtained on the basis of trace epures of polyhedrons taken as a basis. The faces of these shapes are flat polygons, and the edges are line segments. More extensive sets of shapes can be obtained by moving from strictly straight-line elements of a projective drawing (PD) to nonlinear ones using various deformations. For this purpose, a polyhedral three-dimensional object obtained in a standard way in Euclidean space by using PD is subjected to deformation, which leads to the appearance of curved faces. In this article, we used deformations that are described by the simplest analytical expressions: spherical deformation (surfaces acquire positive Gaussian curvature) and hyperbolic deformation (surfaces acquire negative Gaussian curvature).

articleTitle: Using the Data Scientist Experience in Training
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article considers the possibility of using the experience of Data scientist in training. As an example, we used the data scientist algorithm for performing acoustic calculations. Such acoustic calculations are carried out in many training courses, namely, "Environmental Technologies", "Energy Gas and Air Pipelines of Thermal Power Plants", etc. An acoustic calculation takes place in bachelor's and master's works. The main tasks that a Data scientist solves by the example of performing acoustic calculations are considered in stages. The universality of the experience of a data scientist for training is shown.
