On the example of performing acoustic calculations for large energy facilities, the main stages of work are traced from the transformation of the source data into a form suitable for analysis, the actual analysis of the data to their interpretation and application of these data to practice. The importance of visualizing the obtained values in 3D for their interpretation is shown.

articleTitle: Methodological Support for Discipline Modeling Simulation Methods
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This article is devoted to the result of the developed workshop for the course section "Methods of simulation" with the training tasks list. The workshop special feature is the use of schematic and software methods for building automatic control systems. The task example to study the automatic systems operation using SimInTech software, MatLab Simulink, and the MatLab language is given.

articleTitle: Formation of Individual Educational Trajectories in Preparing IT specialists
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The goal setting of the digital economy is presented. The demand for the formation of individual educational trajectories in the training of IT specialists is justified. The importance of integrated formalization systems in the formation of competencies of the digital economy is shown. The reasons for the importance of ensuring information security are described. The features of using intelligent agent technologies to ensure information security are considered. Current trends in the development of research on agent technologies in the field of information security are described. The characteristic methods of formalization integration are revealed by the example of analysis of the influence of agents on the quality of functioning of complex information protection systems. The mathematical apparatus of formalization integration is defined.

articleTitle: The Use of Computer Modeling to Emulate Laboratory Work on The Study of Thermodynamic Properties of Substances
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article describes a virtual laboratory stand on Technical thermodynamics. This bench allows to carry out thermal studies of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> or SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>. The results of the experiment allow to obtain the boiling curve, the specific volumes of boiling liquid and dry saturated vapor, the heat of vaporization, the second virial coefficient, the equation of state, to calculate the tables of the specific volume and enthalpy of the studied substance. The method of experimental data processing with the help of mathematical packages is given.

articleTitle: Interactive Educational Complex on the Basics of "Digital Substation" Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Presented the experience of development of distance learning course focused on the basics of the organization of power utility automation system of power stations and substations. The main pursued purpose, during course creation, was the "visual simulation" of working with real equipment and software. The course is organized on the basis of the educational center of the Department "Electric Stations" of NRU MPEI, equipped with modern microprocessor-based intelligent electronic devices and related software. The description of the object of study and course structure is given. The technology of distance learning is discussed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Free Software for Thermal Calculations
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The paper proposes a method for analyzing the assessment of the functionality and usability of free software for heat engineering calculations. This is necessary to determine the scope of their possible application. For evaluation, free programs of manufacturers of heating equipment and an online calculator of a construction and repair organization were taken. Evaluation of the functionality was carried out by the method of "black box". For testing, we considered the calculations of heat loss in different cities, but with the same construction of walls, floors and ceilings. To assess and accuracy, we compared the values obtained in the studied programs and calculated according to the regulatory documentation of the Russian Federation.

articleTitle: Training Specialists for Developing Digital Power Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The report considers the training of specialists for the development of modern energy equipment: the requirements to the competence of such specialists within the realities of the fourth technological revolution, methodological approaches to practice-oriented training and the application of modern software products. The features of the fourth technological order ('Industry 4.0'), requirements to equipment developers and the structure of the competence model of such specialists are under review. The report also reviews the experience of the National Research University "MPEI" in organization of master's final qualification works within the framework of participation in real projects on energy equipment manufacturing.

articleTitle: Simulation and Fuzzy Logic in Import Substitution Risk Management of High-Tech Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The rational solution to import substitution problem of high-tech equipment using an integrated simulation model with included fuzzy inference engine is discussed below. This problem is created by uncertain conditions of the innovative solutions adoption, which can cause the risk of significant losses. Import substitution of engines on promising small coastal guard vessels was chosen as an example-object of study. As a result, an integrated computer model was created, which is included in the functional composition of the information system that uses insurance subsystem as a risk management tool.

articleTitle: Engineering Calculations of the Glass Annealing Process
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article researches the problems of automated engineering calculations of glass annealing process using mathematical programming environment Matlab. The features of simulation of glass products annealing are formulated. The structure of an automated system for calculating glass annealing is considered. The example of the practical application of designed system for cylindrical glassware is shown. The temperature dependences of the glass properties and relaxation constants are calculated. The temperature and stress fields were simulated for the existing annealing regime. An example of determining the optimal annealing regime providing residual stresses tolerances is given. The efficiency of applying the procedures of the programming environment Matlab for solving thermophysical and optimization problems is shown.

articleTitle: Assessing Information Risks When Using Web Applications Using Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article looks at information risk concepts, how it is assessed, web application vulnerabilities and how to identify them. A prototype web application vulnerability scanner has been developed with a function of information risk assessment based on fuzzy logic. The software developed is used in laboratory sessions on data protection discipline.

articleTitle: Engineering Study for Influence of Deep Neural Network Architectures on Images Recognition Quality
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The paper presents a method for determining the architecture of input layers of a deep neural network based on a preliminary analysis for color channels histograms of processed images. The authors give the results of a study for the application of the proposed method for the problem of binary classification of texture images.

articleTitle: Automated Construction and Analysis of Scientific and Educational Profiles of the University Department
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article proposes an automated method for building scientific and educational profiles of the university department based on the use of Data and Text Mining tools. We form two samples: a sample of publications from the digital library eLibrary.ru (to construct a scientific profile of department) and a sample of courses from electronic versions of educational programs (to construct profiles of educational courses). We describe the algorithms of processing and analysis of text documents. We present the results of approbation of the developed software, algorithmic and methodological support (on the example of the departments of the National Research University "Moscow Power Engineering Institute"). We discuss the advantages, disadvantages and different ways and methods of using our approach.

Author Keywords: processing and analysis of text data
extraction and weighting of informative terms

articleTitle: Virtual Laboratory of Electric Motor in the Discipline of "Electrical Engineering and Electronics"
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The report presents a virtual training laboratory for discipline of electrical machines, developed at the Department of Diagnostic Information Technologies of the National Research University MPEI for the discipline "Electrical Engineering and Electronics" in undergraduate learning. Virtual laboratories consists of two pieces of software: author's simulation programs of electric motors in high-level languages and laboratory work interfaces implemented in JAVA language in integrated application development environment NetBeans (IDE). Methodological support and software for three works with classic motors have been developed (DC motors, induction motor and three-phase synchronous motor). The great capabilities of a virtual laboratory are shown, allowing to increase the efficiency of the educational process.

articleTitle: Experience in Designing and Developing the Educational Game BlockSolver
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This article examines the gamification learning method and demonstrates the examples of applications that use it. The article shows an attempt to design and develop a modern 3D graphics game application based on Unity3D platform to use it for teaching of LIFO and FIFO data manipulation methods. The developed prototype of the BlockSolver game includes a game module, a level builder, and a navigation module. The game module is responsible for the player’s interaction with the virtual world. The level builder allows developing new interaction schemes. The navigation module provides a graphical interface which the user uses to move between the game module levels, level builder, and other additional information presented in BlockSolver. This paper describes the main stages of development and the technologies used. The hardware and technical requirements necessary for the application to work are presented. Development scenarios and prospectives of a prototype are described.

articleTitle: Using "TBT Shell" Software for Online Testing in "Water Treatment" Education Course
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article describes usage of TBT Shell software (developed in Moscow Power Engineering Institute) for providing online testing for specific Water Treatment education course. Few challenges in Water Treatment course, online testing investigated for last three years.

articleTitle: Study of Methods and Skill Experience of Diagnostics of the Main Heating Network State Diagnostics Using a Robotized Diagnostic Complex
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The heat supply sector is a key life-supporting link in the Russian Federation municipal infrastructure. Heat networks from anthropogenic and environmental points of view belong to the potentially dangerous objects category. Each case of heat supply disruption in the our winter conditions is an emergency, the consequences of which can be very serious. The main such accidents causes are defects in the heating networks pipelines operating in variable temperatures conditions, exposure to aggressive environments and electromagnetic disturbances. Timely and reliable progressive defects identification in the heating networks pipelines, as well as a qualitative analysis of of their occurrence causes and prediction of residual life are priority tasks in the heating networks operation.

articleTitle: Intelligent Robotics in the Structure of the Direction "Information Systems and Technologies"
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The use of the anthropomorphic robot NAO Evolution in the educational process of training bachelors and masters at the Department of Informatics and Information Technology of the Vologda State University is considered. The contents of a set of laboratory works on studying the possibilities of controlling robot mechanisms in the Choregraphe software package, methods for constructing real-time behavior scenarios, and the possibility of organizing a dialogue with the robot in a natural language are discussed. Fragments of programs that implement the studied possibilities are given.

articleTitle: On Approach to Training in Methods of Software Working Out
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article analyzes the approach to teaching the software design and work-out methods in the framework of "Business-informatics". It proposes developing the teaching process proceeding from the analysis of software reliability criterion. Support of software reliability requirements follows all the steps of software life cycle and implementation of this requirement guarantees the high-quality software development. Special aspects of teaching data engineering within the frame of "Business-Informatics" specialty are described. The thesis considering the used IT relating rather to typical "basic" technologies than to unique IT is analyzed. At the same time the main property of academic activity is its engineering not scientific character. Higher school outputs primarily "the basic" knowledge and qualification in a definite subject domain of modern economic life. Opinion is advanced that in the "Business-Informatics" framework the typical widespread "basic" IT should be taught. The subject steering documents are proposed to be revised toward increase in study hours on IT introduction, backing and practical application and decrease in hours for developing and designing the info systems and IT. Proposal of configuring the software development method study process on the basis of maintenance of reliability criterion instead of now spread in-depth study of all software development is derived from this approach. Such approach is built around basic knowledge of the software life cycle without detailed and in-depth study of the software every life cycle. It is suspected that the business IT specialist mastering such approach will govern successfully the processes of high-quality software designing and developing.Capacity of Specs for software development is analyzed. It is proposed to include a description of quality parameters, clear for the end user, in the Specs to ensure the software reliability. Description of the main reliability provision requirements is given herein.

articleTitle: Software Implementation of the Neural Network Controller in Systems with Complementary Correction of the Control Action
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The paper deals with the issues of software implementation of the neural network controller or the neural network in automatic control systems with complementary correction of the control action. The requirements to the neural network in the complementary correction circuit are determined. The algorithm of error back propagation with regularization is adopted as a training algorithm. Its software implementation in MATLAB Simulink package is given. The results of simulation of ACS with the neural network controller are presented. These control systems structures can be effectively used by various objects and technological processes.

articleTitle: The Use of Digital Technologies in Teaching a Foreign Language
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article reveals one of the acute aspects of higher education – the use of modern digital technologies. The article describes the possibilities of modern service programs used in the learning process, methods of presentation of educational material and knowledge control. The interpenetration of the content of different academic disciplines as a factor of creating a unified educational space through modern digital technologies is analyzed in the article. The use of modern digital technologies is considered as a factor of successful mastering of educational material. The authors come to the conclusion that the productive use of digital technologies, the involving students in an independent search, the selection of information forms students' competencies that meet modern requirements. Using test system developed at MPEI for grammar assignments is presented in the article.

articleTitle: Multimedia Academic Manual "Database Application Development"
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: A review of the current state of open access multimedia academic manuals and electronic learning resources in the field of programming and database application development is provided. A review of similar online courses hosted on national and global platforms in the field was conducted. The experience of developing a multimedia tutorial on the use of the Delphi programming language for developing applications designed for integrated work with databases is described. The integration of a multimedia academic manual in an interdisciplinary learning management system (LMS), implemented on a dedicated server in the modular object-oriented distance learning environment Moodle and the organization of the final knowledge control, is considered.

articleTitle: Automated Сomplex for Researching High-Speed Electric Turbomachines
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article deals with the development and research of high-speed electric turbomachines on foil bearings. Experimental studies of electric turbomachines samples allow us to identify the main features of work processes in their critical nodes. The description of laboratory experimental stands and information-measuring systems for collecting and processing data, as well as the results of experimental studies of the characteristics of foil bearings and electric turbomachines are presented.

articleTitle: The Construction of Simplified Models of a Multi-Timescale System on the Basis of Processes Implementations
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The report is devoted to the problem of constructing simplified models of multi-timescale dynamic systems. The general case of decomposition of a two-timescale linear system model with the reduction of its dimension by several orders is considered. A feature of the decomposition procedure is the use of processes implementations corresponding to state variables as initial information. This makes it possible to obtain implementations experimentally as well as analytically in the presence of a description of the system in the Cauchy normal form. We propose a procedure for finding holonomic relationships between the variables that make it possible to reduce the order of the initial model, as well as methods of residual functions or sliding determinant to determine the restrictions on the simplified model time domain. The design estimate of accuracy of the simplified model is given, followed by refinement by simulation of processes. An example illustrating the proposed approach to constructing a simplified model of a multi-timescale system is given. The procedure for constructing a simplified model can be fully implemented by means of MATLAB/Simulink software package.

Author Keywords: model in the form of processes implementations

articleTitle: Short-Circuit Currents from Wind Turbine Generators Study in Laboratory Workshop
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Expertise in renewables is essential component of higher education in electrical engineering nowadays. Being the worldwide trend studies on renewable sources of electrical energy are extensively developing in Russia. Russian state authorities are confident in their plan to put in operation a huge capacity of wind power generation over the next several years. Wind power plants reliability depends on the proper sizing of electrical equipment for power output to the grid. Short-circuit study is a vital routine for sizing the electrical equipment and setting the protection parameters. Influence of wind turbine generators (WTG) to the fault current depends on the type of generator according to [1]. Ability of estimation the WTG infeed to the fault current and understanding the key WTG parameters are important for wind power plants designers and operational engineers. The laboratory workshop for shot-circuit study in grids with wind turbine generators has been developed using PSS SINCAL software. Workshop is based on simulation the transients during short-circuit faults. Laboratory assignment consists of theoretical and experimental guidelines. Brief description of transients in WTG of different types accompanied with analytical expressions for rough estimation of current infeed was proposed. Experimental part of the workshop includes several cases of simulation the transients during short-circuit faults.

articleTitle: A Technique of Protocol Construction for Detecting Compromises of Secret Keys
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Currently a single user often utilizes multiple devices to get access to applications, for example, messengers. A way to provide the necessary level of information security is monitoring the legitimacy of using client devices according to a set of access rights. In this paper, we suggest a cryptographic protocol for detecting compromises of secret keys based on blockchain technology. In contrast with currently available solutions, the blockchain-based protocol allows controlling usage of all long-term cryptographic keys, as well as every key in a chain of short-term keys. Besides that, an additional audit service can be used for monitoring secure messaging protocols. Moreover, the protocol includes an authentication service for users. All these techniques make the idea of blockchain-based protocol promising.

articleTitle: Quality Control of Training in Engineering and Computer Graphics
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Today it is difficult to overestimate the role of information technology in human life. They are present everywhere and facilitate, help a person. Including in education, information technologies are actively used to educate students and to manage the learning process and to control the quality of education. The article describes one of the information systems that allow monitoring the quality of student learning. Moreover, with the help of this system, students' successes are monitored daily, and not 1-2 times per semester: at the control and validation events, as before. Constant monitoring and timely assistance to students in case of difficulties arising motivates students and forces them to work intensively and systematically, without jerks (before the test, for example) and delays due to "gaps" in knowledge because of misunderstanding or difficulty.

articleTitle: Application of MatLab for Processing X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy Spectra
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The present work is devoted to the application of MatLab package for decoding and analysis of energy spectra of photoelectrons obtained in the study of ultrathin films by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). The use of MatLab language for the development of programs for decoding and analysis of XPS spectra of the solid surface study is the most appropriate because of the available internal capabilities of the software. The MatLab software package allows to perform elemental and phase analyses, and also allows to determine the thickness of layers of ultrathin films on the surface of a solid.

articleTitle: The Calculation and Study of Pipe Operation of Low-Pressure Circuit of Heat Recovery Steam Generators
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article presents the experience of using modern software in the implementation of thermal calculations. The integral characteristics of the high-pressurized heat recovery steam generator and the common 3-pressure heat recovery steam generator for high-capacity combined cycle gas turbine are determined and compared. The comparison shows that the increased pressure leads to an intensification of heat transfer, which is shown in the increase in the heat transfer coefficient. In addition, the problems of reliability of heat recovery steam generator, in particular problems related to flow-accelerated corrosion in pipes, are considered.

articleTitle: Matlab Application to Calculate Natural Oscillations of Beam Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: This paper presents Matlab application in course project in discipline Dynamics of Machines for students learning Applied Mechanics in NRU MPEI, Institute of Power Engineering and Mechanics. Determining of natural frequencies and shapes is shown by example a hinge-supported beam with a concentrated mass supported by springs. It is considered three methods for finding natural frequencies and shapes of the system: 1) direct method from non-triviality condition of solution of governing equation, 2) method of initial parameters and 3) finite element method. Matlab functions and procedures, including graphical representation of the results, is illustrated. Numerical investigation and comparative analysis of accuracy by three methods are given.

articleTitle: Distant Modeling of NIZK Protocol for Public Keys Certification
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: We present the IT solutions for educational modeling of non-interactive zero knowledge (NIZK) cryptographic public keys certification protocols. Certified public keys can then be used in a variety of non-interactive protocols, for example, in protocols using technique designated verifier proofs. The solution is based on algebraic means provided by MPEI algebraic processor. The IT solution supports the following educational purposes: obtaining practical skills of remote implementation of multiple non-interactive oblivious transfer and of non-interactive zero-knowledge proof protocol, mastering the methods of a remote automatic modeling of cryptographic protocols and of non-interactive public keys certification, and the technique designated verifier proofs.

articleTitle: Model of Piezoelectric Transducers for the Metrological Characteristics Study of Ultrasonic Measuring Instruments
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article describes the use of IT-technologies in the educational process and scientific laboratories by the example of studying primary measuring transducers, in particular, piezoelectric transducers. A mathematical model of the similar transducers, which are an integral part of an ultrasonic liquid flowmeter, is considered and refined. Equivalent electrical circuits are presented for both individual transducers and the entire flowmeter electro-acoustic path as a whole. The analysis of the dynamic characteristics of the flowmeter path is performed. Studies of the indicated transducers transfer functions in different modes have been carried out. The influence of the receiving- generating circuit parameters of ultrasonic flowmeters on the fluid flow rate measuring accuracy has been established and justified. The asymmetry reducing problem of the flowmeter electro-acoustic path when determining the propagation time measurement of probing signals, the difference of which is proportional to the fluid velocity and flow rate, is indicated. Modeling and experimental verification confirmed the obtained results of the flow measurement error.

articleTitle: The Architecture of Intelligent Agent-based Educational System for Training Students in a Technical University
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article presents the development, implementation and approbation of a multi-level architecture of the intelligent agent-based educational system for training of technical specialists. The proposed architecture combines openness, flexibility and good scalability. This article shows how these quality indicators were achieved through a combination of multi-agent and service-oriented approaches. It describes the purpose and components of each level, presents some key aspects of the implementation and shows the results of pedagogical experiments.

articleTitle: Quality Engineering Education in the Context of Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: In the context of Industry 4.0, power engineering is receiving new challenges, which require finding adequate answers related to the introduction of innovative tech The standards regulating people's social and economic life do not keep up with the development of the digital world. In result the larger this gap, the greater the risks of accidents, hacker attacks, and data leaks. Cybersecurity reduces these risks with the help of highly qualified specialists.In modern conditions, the implementation of national projects "Digital economy of the Russian Federation", "Education", "Science" the demands for professionally trained specialists are increasing. And these specialists in its turn are the driving force in the development of Industry 4.0 technologies. Successful training of future specialists is impossible without strong universities that have links with advanced sectors of the economy, which is achieved, on the one hand, by the constant monitoring of Supervisory agencies for the implementation of legislation, and, on the other hand, by the desire of universities to become competitive in the global educational space in an innovative economy.

articleTitle: Features of Teaching Economic Disciplines to Students of Engineering Specialties
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: the authors raise the problem of teaching economic disciplines to students of engineering specialties; prove the necessity and effectiveness of using modern interactive teaching methods, namely, business computer games. The article proposes five formats for conducting training sessions using business computer games, and evaluates the effectiveness of such classes.

articleTitle: Coordinated Resources Allocation Heuristics in Distributed Computing
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: In this work, we propose and study heuristics for parallel jobs execution and efficient resources co-allocation in heterogeneous computing environments. Existing modern job- flow execution features and realities impose many restrictions for the resources allocation procedures and applicable scheduling criteria. Subject to these restrictions a special dynamic programming scheme is proposed to select resources depending on their meta-features as secondary scheduling criteria. Such secondary optimization criteria are commonly referred as breaking a tie rules. Thus, while maintaining the same primary scheduling criterion outcomes it is sometimes possible to affect global resources utilization efficiency by choosing the appropriate secondary criteria. Basing on a conservative backfilling algorithm we study different breaking a tie heuristic strategies and their affect on the integral job-flow execution characteristics.

articleTitle: Information-Measuring Systems Introduction: Engineering Education Information Support
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: It is true that lack of a systematic approach to minimizing risks of engineering education causes inefficient projects that intend to implement information measuring systems. The purpose of the study is to develop engineering education software applied for introducing information measuring systems according to the criterion of minimizing risks in a professional occupation. The authors developed invariant models to design and evaluate the effectiveness of safe adopting automated information measuring system (AIMS). The use of these models allows one to minimize economic losses caused by incomplete competencies and consideration for all other participants in the roll-out process. As a result of the applied models, the security of implementation has increased and costs reduced by 35% in comparison with the traditional option. Competency models have developed to generate special path dependency when operating with AIMS. As a result of network planning, models allow minimizing economic losses connected with a lack of awareness about educational background, certificates and work experience based on continuous and integrated education. The difference between an ineffective and effective version of single path dependency is more than 10%. The authors suggest a group of actions that provide the safe operation of computer-aided tools and personnel training for working in new conditions. The application of study findings for energy-intensive plants in Chelyabinsk and the Amur Region contributes to cost savings dealt with safe operation management of information measuring systems counting electricity and energy products.

articleTitle: Mobile Technologies in Blended Learning of Engineering Students in Digital Measurements on Geodetic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: Vocational training of engineering students includes digital measurements using a lot of portable devices and instruments. The probability of erroneous actions also significantly increases with complications and number of devices. At the initial stages of training, students are encouraged to master the basic actions with virtual laboratory equipment before start and further in the process of working with devices. The article discusses the possible options for hybrid laboratory construction to support engineering courses such as enginery geodesy at the University of Architecture and Civil Engineering. Hybrid laboratories provide both physical and online forms of operation with the same equipment or devices of the same functionality. Since online tools should simulate correct and erroneous sampling with the possibility of user's automated control the choice of virtual tools rather than remote access to production laboratory equipment is more preferable for didactic tasks at initial stages. A simple configuration of hybrid learning environment based on interactive virtual learning tools and mobile devices is offered for training of inexperienced students to make digital measurements on geodetic equipment. The hybrid environment is equally suitable for use in stationary university laboratories and for terrain practice. In conclusion, the article discusses the use of distance and mobile technologies in blended learning for students using "flipped class" and professional business game methods in the engineering geodesy course at the University of Architecture and Civil Engineering.

Author Keywords: training in work with geodetic equipment

articleTitle: An Approach to Solve the Problem of Creating an Automatic Knowledge Control System Based on Text Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: We consider the use of text processing and analysis methods to create an automatic knowledge control system that evaluates the learning and understanding of educational material based on written answers. We indicate the part of the knowledge control system where semantic analysis of texts takes place. the system uses a text similarity algorithm based on distributive relationships, as well as a specific method for calculating the score of foreign words or formulas. The text processing methods used are described; the place of semantic analysis in knowledge control systems is shown, an example of the algorithm's operation on real data is given. The results of this article show that using this system has a significant impact on the educational process and is a viable solution.

articleTitle: Modern Media Technologies in Teaching German Language to STEM-Students
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The article dwells on the possibilities of using the media portal for STEM teaching at a technical university in order to integrate general professional knowledge with language competence. The central stage of the research is the methodological potential of German-language materials for STEM-students developed by Siemens Stiftung in teaching foreign languages to students of technical subjects.

articleTitle: The Benefits of Mining Techniques in Digital Transformation of Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The paper discusses the problems of digital transformation of education and the features of Industry 4.0 through the involvement of ICT. The impact of both in the engineering education are described. Some principles of Data mining and Process mining are presented. These play an important role in education of future professionals in the engineering domain that is in line with the goals of the next industrial revolution.

articleTitle: Learning Skills Development Through the Usage of Simulators
publicationTitle: 2020 V International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education ( Inforino )
abstract: The phenomenon of globalization has resulted in an increase in importance of economic and commercial practices. In this environment in order to increase company competitiveness it is critical to improve logistic activities at all levels of the organization.The main mission of these activities is to place the right products (goods and services) in the right place, at the right time, with the desired conditions, and at the lowest cost. In summary, the objective of logistics is to guarantee customer satisfaction by achieving the best cost, quality and service conditions.Unfortunately, the goal of building a systemic vision of logistics achieved by the coordination of different processes not been achieved through traditional teaching methods. In addition, the number of academic simulators in this discipline is very low. This is why the professors of the logistics area of Tecnologico de Monterrey have been designing and testing a business game with a focus on logistics decision making. Logistic Simulator (LOST) is a thorough game that allows students to develop and apply logistics concepts in a fast and fun way to learn. Thus allowing to understand the interfaces of different logistic topics. The game shows the participants the consequences of the different decisions that are made through a series of key performance indicators, thus promoting the identification of the main variables that should be evaluated when making each decision. LOST represents a new way of learning and managing logistic concepts. In addition, LOST triggers in students the development of various skills such as Self-regulated learning, Student Engagement and Reflection on their learning.This article aims to describe the design of this simulator, the strategies we have followed to provoke learning in our students, and show the main results that have been obtained in the development of the aforementioned skills.
